tasks.repository: To be selected by resource and native-workflow admission, not by observed gain

protocol.interventions_and_repairs: Record every operator action and framework/native/external failure. Engineering development runs cannot be retrospectively relabelled zero-intervention frozen trials. Formal harness changes preserve the interrupted trial and require a new version.
protocol.full_cost_accounting: Match the complete research resource package; disclose model USD including unknown holds, GPU device time, CPU/wall time, storage, failures and shared initialization. No per-cell automatic 24-hour reset. Published weights are calibration, not independent research repetitions.
protocol.comparison_scope: Native repository integration and metric optimization; not a mandatory data-acquisition contest. Generic research has the same lawful tools/resources including an expert when available. Compare autoresearch-robotics separately on a common native template, or label a repository-adaptation extension explicitly. Do not classify a previously debugged repository as unseen.
